messages:
Evelyn Park: quick idea dump — we need a "canary governor" that fuses multiple signals and enforces a grace/hysteresis before any automated fallback. goal: reduce false positives and avoid noisy user-facing rollbacks.
Jonas Meyer: +1. what signals are we fusing? latency/error/quality/throughput?
Evelyn Park: at minimum: p95 latency, 5xx rate, per-tenant error spike (z-score), and optional eval quality score. each gets a confidence weight.
Tara Singh: weights are fine, but we need combinator rules. propose: weighted-score > threshold && at least one hard-fail (5xx > X) OR sustained window (>Y sec).
Jonas Meyer: also include variance check to avoid transient jitter. use rolling window with min samples.
Evelyn Park: governance: decision only after N consecutive windows pass rule. then governor emits a "candidate rollback" with rationale and confidence. human review only for high-impact tenants.
SRE Bot: note: add tenant-impact metadata: qps, active sessions, SLA tier. this determines auto-action allowed.
Tara Singh: good. tiers: platinum/enterprise can require manual approval unless critical. self-serve tenants default to auto.
Jonas Meyer: actuator taxonomy: 1) route-swap (previous stable), 2) model-fallback (lightweight model), 3) throttled-degrade (reduce concurrency), 4) circuit-open (kill new sessions). define rights per tier.
Evelyn Park: safety: each actuator must support a two-phase apply: PREPARE (dry-run inject) -> COMMIT. Prep validates target exists and estimated capacity.
Tara Singh: and every COMMIT returns a `commit_id` we reconcile against. if router doesn't report `commit_id` in T seconds, governor marks rollback failed and retries/alerts.
OpsAlice: how to avoid rollback storms across regions? we should shard decisions by partition key (tenant) and rate-limit cross-region ops.
Jonas Meyer: partitioning per-tenant makes sense. governor runs per-region but has a global coordinator for multi-region tenants to avoid split-brain. coordinator elects leader for a tenant using simple lease.
Evelyn Park: hysteresis config: initial hold = 2 windows, cool-down = max(30s, severity*window), progressive backoff on repeated rollbacks. store per-tenant cooldown state in primary KV with TTL.
Tara Singh: what about replayability for postmortems? decision events must carry: inputs (metric snapshots), rule version, commit_id, actor (auto/manual), and pre/post routes. keep immutable.
SRE Bot: compliance note: for Private installs, provide opt-in logs export. default: local-only audit; opt-in: anonymized digests to central.
Jonas Meyer: testing: simulate noisy network for 10k tenants for 1h. verify false-positive rate < 0.5% and mean time to safe-rollback < target.
Evelyn Park: UX: Console shows in-flight candidate rollbacks, with expand to see signals and ability to abort. add an "explain" link that shows the computed weighted score and contributing signals.
OpsAlice: RBAC: who can override? policy: owners + ops for tenant; platform admins global. audit trail mandatory.
Tara Singh: operations: on rollback success, schedule a short probe flood to validate correctness. if probe fails, automatically re-open circuit and escalate.
Jonas Meyer: metrics: track governor precision/recall (against human-reviewed incidents), average time from detection->action, rollback revert rate within 10m.
Evelyn Park: data retention: keep raw metric windows 14d, decision events 90d, audit traces 365d for enterprise. redact tokens and inputs.
SRE Bot: alerting: automated-action-failed => page SRE if tenant tier >= enterprise OR repeated failures > 3 in 1h.
deploy-bot: test-deploy of canary-governor-sim passed: sim-0.9 on staging :white_check_mark:
Evelyn Park: action items: Jonas + Tara to draft rule DSL + contract for `candidate_rollback` event; OpsAlice to spec RBAC; I'll prototype explain page. two-week spike.
Jonas Meyer: starting DSL doc now, will link PR to `rfc/canary-governor-dsl.md`.
Tara Singh: I'll draft actuator two-phase API and sample flows.
OpsAlice: will write RBAC doc and test matrix.
Evelyn Park: awesome. we'll review in weekly arch sync. keeping this thread as the single source of async notes.
